phase: Carrier phase reset to zero for each active symbol; implementation assumption
timing: Known transmit boundary plus peak of mean measured power-delay profile; no synchronizer
doppler: Bulk V0 remains removed, as in supplied TVIRs; time-varying residual channel retained. Not the default sfetch Doppler reinstatement.
detector: Exact-tone quadrature matched energies, not the unspecified paper FFT-band detector
fixed_noise_reference: Received energy divided by active samples in 8 ms/no-guard reference, per sounding; fixed across guard and duration
packet_placement: Each configuration fills the record with its own packet duration; endpoints and packet times differ. Not paired packet observations.
goodput: Truth-known error-free 128-bit packets divided by transmit+guard+padding time; idealized discard model without CRC, preamble, ACK or retransmission
uncertainty: Per-sounding min/max are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Adjacent soundings and bits may be dependent.
